name: zone-free-native
full_name: Build with material points only, no zones
description: MPM does not need the zone family. This path uses only 'mpoint' commands and leaves zone.count() at zero throughout. Prefer it when the geometry can be described by a range, and reach for zones only when you need a primitive shape they can author and ranges cannot.

steps.command: mpoint generate resolution 1 range position-x -0.4 0.4 position-y -0.4 0.4 position-z -0.4 0.4
steps.why: 'resolution' is material points per node spacing per axis; the default is 2, so 'resolution 1' is one point per cell.
Must precede 'mpoint property' -- without a model the engine answers 'There are no constitutive models in material points.'
'density' is a model property here. There is no 'mpoint density' command.

steps.command: mpoint node fix velocity range position-z 0

verified.result: Cycles and settles with zone.count() == 0 at every step.
